full_prompt_en: A square red-and-black graphic image shows a tightly packed group of people in vigorous motion, their bodies overlapping until the scene becomes a dense field of bent limbs and dark faces. The background is almost entirely hidden by the crowd, with hot crimson filling the gaps between black silhouettes. In the center-right foreground, one person in a bright red shirt and trousers bends forward with legs spread wide, the nearest pale-red shoes planted at the bottom edge. To the left, another figure sits or crouches lower, one knee sharply raised and a sleeve folded into bold dark creases. Around them, several heads and reaching arms press into the upper half; their faces are mostly shadowed, but the glances and gestures create a sense of shared intensity. A long arm crossing the middle joins the left and right clusters, while the bright clothing makes a jagged diagonal across the central black mass. The dark areas are not simply blank: rough hatching, thick brush-like cuts, and narrow red highlights follow muscles and folds. Crimson remains the only strong color, shifting from luminous scarlet on clothing and exposed ground to darker wine-red within bodies and shadows. There is no clear separate horizon or readable sign, and the crop pushes activity beyond every edge. Light is rendered as a graphic division of red planes and black recesses rather than a natural source, with high-value red shapes isolated against near-black figures and no realistic cast shadows. The overall composition is confrontational and kinetic, compressing many human forms into a pounding rhythm of scarlet, black, diagonal arms, and angular knees.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形红黑图像描绘一群挤在一起、动作激烈的人物，身体层层交叠，使场景化成弯曲四肢与深色面孔组成的密集色域。背景几乎完全被人群遮住，炽热绯红填进黑色剪影之间的空隙。中央偏右前景，一人穿鲜红上衣和裤子向前弯身，两腿张开，近处浅红色鞋踩在下画边。左侧另一人坐得或蹲得更低，一条膝盖明显抬起，衣袖折成粗重深色褶线。周围几颗头和伸出的手臂挤入上半部；脸部大多在阴影中，但视线与动作共同形成强烈情绪。一只横过中部的长手臂连接左右两组人，鲜亮衣服则在中央黑色大块里形成锯齿状斜线。暗部并非空白：粗排线、厚刷痕般切口和细红色亮痕顺着肌肉与衣褶延伸。绯红是唯一强色，从衣料与露出地面的发亮猩红，变为身体与阴影里的深酒红。画面没有清楚的独立地平线或可读标识，裁切让活动延伸出每道画边。光线以红色平面和黑色凹处的图形分割表达，而非自然光源；高明度红形孤立于近黑人物前，没有写实投影。整体构图逼人且充满动能，把许多人体压缩成猩红、黑色、斜向手臂和折角膝部的强烈节奏。
style_prompt_en: The graphic image compresses many interlocking forms into a near-binary field of hot scarlet and deep black. Thick shadow masses and jagged red cuts establish the main rhythm, while rough hatching and smaller curved strokes give the dark areas internal energy. Cropping remains tight at every edge, with little quiet background and no stable horizon; overlapping diagonals keep the eye moving. Value contrast is direct and forceful rather than softly graded, and color variation stays within a narrow red-to-wine range. Illumination reads as selective graphic exposure of planes, not a realistically modeled light source. The overall treatment is intense, tactile, and poster-like, using density, abrupt edges, and a restricted palette to create visual pressure.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅图形图像把许多交锁形体压缩成近乎二元的炽红与深黑色域。厚重阴影块和锯齿状红色切口建立主要节奏，粗排线与较小弧笔赋予暗部内部动能。每道画边都裁得紧密，安静背景很少，也没有稳定地平线；叠合斜线使视线不断移动。明度对比直接而有力，不作柔和渐层，色彩变化限制在狭窄的红到酒红范围。照明像选择性露出的图形平面，而非写实塑形的光源。整体处理强烈、可触且似海报，以密度、突然断开的边缘和有限色盘制造视觉压力。
theme_en: A tightly packed group of people in vigorous motion rendered in red and black
theme_zh: 一群挤在一起、动作激烈的人物，以红黑双色呈现
name: Cleon Peterson
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
